courses.title: Data Visualization
courses.description: Introduces the principles and tools of data visualization and visual storytelling with R. Learn foundational and advanced plotting techniques to create impactful visuals and interactive dashboards, transforming raw data into compelling data-driven stories for diverse audiences.

courses.title: Capstone Project Seminar
courses.prerequisiteText: Admission into the Social Data Analytics Minor and 18 units completed in the minor.
courses.description: Final capstone group project that applies the skills students have learned in their studies to gain experience tackling real-world policy and social problems and develop a portfolio that they can showcase to prospective employers or graduate programs. Topics vary.
